results.title: NA Secretariat suspends security assistant Waqas Ahmed over alleged misuse of authority
results.description: ISLAMABAD - The National Assembly Secretariat has issued orders for the suspension of Security Assistant Waqas Ahmed over the alleged misuse of authority under Rule 5(1) of the Government Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 2020.

results.title: PPP challenges re-polling at nine stations, citing Zia Qamar’s decisive lead
results.description: ISLAMABAD - Pakistan People’s Party (PPP) challenged the decision to hold re-polling at nine polling stations, claiming that PPP candidate Sardar Zia Qamar had already secured a clear and decisive lead.

results.title: Iowa Libertarians nominate new candidates for lt. governor, 3rd District
results.description: Iowa Libertarians have named new candidates for lieutenant governor and the 3rd District after earlier nominees were removed from the 2026 ballot.

results.title: Venezuela government, opposition wrap up round of post-Maduro talks
results.description: A joint statement highlighted agreement on two topics after several days of discussion: reforming the judiciary, and seeking access to frozen funds to aid in earthquake recovery efforts.

results.title: Livestream, live updates: More police testimony expected in Lindsay Clancy trial
results.description: Plymouth, MA – August 11: Lindsay Clancy listens to testimony during her murder trial at Plymouth Superior Court on August 11, 2026. (Photo by Jonathan Wiggs/The Boston Globe via Getty Images)

results.title: No 'advance tips': Govt issues guidelines for tipping cab drivers, asks aggregators to stop pre-ride prompts — report
results.description: The government reportedly cited a clause in the guidelines that specifies that passengers may give drivers a voluntary tip only after the journey is complete.
